name: @adjacent/openclaw-plugin
description: Adjacent prediction-market workflows for OpenClaw: daily briefs, tradable snapshots, and chart artifacts. Read-only; never places orders.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run bundle
scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:check: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js --check
